crossRefs.note: On the top of the pillars was lily work: so the work of the pillars was finished.

translations.web: On the top of the pillars was lily work: so the work of the pillars was finished.
translations.bsb: And the tops of the pillars were shaped like lilies. So the work of the pillars was completed.
translations.kjv: And upon the top of the pillars was lily work: so was the work of the pillars finished.
translations.asv: And upon the top of the pillars was lily-work: so was the work of the pillars finished.
